description: MetaRalph Phase 12: Strategic Planning - Roadmap generation, market analysis, competitive intelligence, feature prioritization.

userStories.title: Implement project roadmap generator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to generate strategic roadmaps for projects.
acceptanceCriteria: src/strategy/roadmap.ts exports RoadmapGenerator class
Analyzes: existing issues, user feedback, competitive landscape
Generates quarterly/yearly roadmap with milestones
Prioritizes features by: impact, effort, strategic value
Creates PRD drafts for roadmap items
Roadmap stored in project and visualized in dashboard
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement competitive analysis
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to analyze competitors to inform feature decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: src/strategy/competitive.ts exports CompetitiveAnalyzer class
Monitors competitor: GitHub repos, changelogs, documentation
Identifies: new features, differentiators, gaps
Suggests features to match or differentiate
Tracks competitive positioning over time
Requires user to configure competitor list
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement user feedback analyzer
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to analyze user feedback to prioritize features.
acceptanceCriteria: src/strategy/feedback.ts exports FeedbackAnalyzer class
Sources: GitHub issues, discussions, stars context
Clusters feedback into themes and feature requests
Scores requests by: frequency, sentiment, user importance
Creates strategic proposals from top requests
Tracks feature request trends over time
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement strategic proposal generator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to proactively propose strategic improvements.
acceptanceCriteria: src/strategy/proposer.ts exports StrategicProposer class
Uses Claude to analyze project and suggest improvements
Considers: market trends, user needs, technical debt, growth opportunities
Generates detailed proposals with rationale and impact estimate
Proposals require user discussion before becoming PRDs
Runs on schedule (default: weekly)
